summary: XCHG Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 with the SEC. The filing is a routine annual disclosure requirement for foreign private issuers. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender offer, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is indicated. The press release merely informs shareholders and ADS holders of the availability of the annual report. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
